# qhook

> Lightweight webhook gateway and workflow engine written in Rust. Single binary, zero external dependencies — no Redis, no RabbitMQ. SQLite for dev, Postgres or MySQL for production. Receive webhooks with signature verification (13 providers), send outbound webhooks (Standard Webhooks), execute HTTP actions with retry, DLQ, and multi-step workflow orchestration.

qhook handles the full lifecycle of webhook and event processing: receive events from external webhooks or internal APIs, route them to handlers or multi-step workflows, and deliver HTTP actions reliably with automatic retry, circuit breaker, and dead letter queue. Configuration is a single YAML file. Install via `cargo install qhook` or Docker (`ghcr.io/totte-dev/qhook`).

Key capabilities:
- Inbound webhook verification: GitHub, Stripe, Shopify, Twilio, Paddle, PagerDuty, Grafana, Terraform Cloud, GitLab, Linear, Standard Webhooks (Clerk/Resend/etc.), HMAC, AWS SNS X.509
- Outbound webhooks with Standard Webhooks compliant signatures, dynamic endpoint management, and subscription-based routing
- Workflow orchestration: multi-step pipelines with branching, parallelism, catch/rollback, and timeouts
- Built-in queue with configurable retry (exponential backoff, jitter), dead letter queue, and stale job recovery
- Event filtering with JSONPath expressions and payload transformation
- Circuit breaker, rate limiting, and IP allowlisting per source
- Prometheus metrics, health checks, Slack/Discord alerts, OpenTelemetry tracing
- CLI tools: start, init, validate, send, inspect, doctor, tail, export, replay-local
- CloudEvents support (binary and structured mode)
- Cron triggers for periodic event generation

## Examples

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/totte-dev/qhook/tree/main/examples/quickstart): Minimal setup, no Docker needed
- [GitHub Webhook](https://github.com/totte-dev/qhook/tree/main/examples/github-webhook): GitHub push/PR with signature verification and fan-out
- [Filter & Transform](https://github.com/totte-dev/qhook/tree/main/examples/filter-transform): Event filtering and payload transformation
- [Stripe Checkout](https://github.com/totte-dev/qhook/tree/main/examples/stripe-checkout): Stripe checkout with dual handlers
- [Workflow](https://github.com/totte-dev/qhook/tree/main/examples/workflow): Multi-step pipeline with catch routing
- [Tenant Provisioning](https://github.com/totte-dev/qhook/tree/main/examples/tenant-provision): Tenant provisioning with rollback and auth headers
- [Alert Remediation](https://github.com/totte-dev/qhook/tree/main/examples/alert-remediation): PagerDuty alert triage, remediate, and escalate
- [Outbound Webhook](https://github.com/totte-dev/qhook/tree/main/examples/outbound-webhook): Send webhooks to customers with Standard Webhooks signatures
